shortDescription: US payrolls growth got back on track in August, consistent with a steady labor market that is helping the Federal Reserve focus more intently on inflation, according to Bloomberg.The report backs former Fed Governor Kevin Warsh’s view of the labor market.

title: US August Payrolls Rebound Supports Warsh’s Labor Market View
